Welcome to Escape Room 5.... 🔎✨
- The latest game in the Escape Room Series!
- BRAND new puzzles! ✨🧩
- All-time and Daily Escape Leaderboards 🏆
- Randomized codes every single play through🎮
- Lots of NEW rooms to explore and have fun with your friends!

You are locked inside of a room, not knowing how or when you got there, or where you are. 
Escape each room by solving puzzles, while strange things await you behind each door. 


🔓Solve the puzzles and escape by yourself or with your friends 

🧠Some puzzles will require you to use your intuition 

💎Explore a range of different rooms, crafted to test your abilities 

⚡There are currently 50 rooms in the Escape Room
Make sure you give the game a 👍 THUMBS UP and a ⭐ FAVOURITE if you enjoy it so we know you want more :)
